purpose: Keep pre-publish gate assets using consistent fields and blocker wording.

required_fields.meaning: whether a real system was triggered

consistency_rules: If gate_state is pending_confirmation, no publishable conclusion may appear.
real_system_triggered must be false in this stage.
Multi-platform checks for the same task must keep per-platform states and not collapse into one global state.
When a redline blocker exists, next_action can only be blocker registration or manager decision.
If publishing release confirmation is missing, WeCom replies must refuse publishing commands.
failure_handling: Generate field-gap or state-conflict lists only; do not modify real configs, publish, or send WeCom messages.
